quote: For example, the smallest C. isabellum had an approximated 4,830 saccular HCs, while the largest had a 3 fold increase to approximately 14,492.
conditions: Smallest fish among those with a saccular count; the paper prints no body length for this fish. Saccular hair cell totals come from 15 saccules of 18 individuals (12 females, 6 males; total length 40.5 to 82.0 cm) from commercial fishers at Leigh, New Zealand. The paper gives only the smallest and largest saccular totals (no per-fish or size-class table) and reports that total hair cell number increases with total length; this value is one extreme of that series, not a species mean. Saccular macular area nearly doubled from 792,153 µm2 in a 40 cm juvenile to 1,524,930 µm2 in an 81 cm adult (not stated to be the counted fish). Utricle, lagena and macula neglecta not covered. Anatomy only; hearing not tested.
